description: Sneak past golem vision cones to reach the exit portal across 5 levels.
fireSafetyLesson: If you smell smoke, stay low and get out fast — smoke rises, clean air stays low!
title: BOULDER'S BLOCKADE

description: Run Cinder's lava diner — tap the correct dish buttons in order before customers lose patience.
fireSafetyLesson: Grown-ups cook — kids stay 3 feet from the stove!
title: CINDER'S SLIDE

description: Burrow through dirt to collect 10 crystals while boulders fall when unsupported.
fireSafetyLesson: Never dig or play near construction sites — heavy things can fall!
title: LORD INFERNO'S STRIKE

description: Cut swinging ropes at the perfect moment to swing Blaze to the next rope or the safe nest.
fireSafetyLesson: Never swing or climb near hot stoves or fireplaces!
title: MAGMA JUMP 2D

description: Place dominoes to build a chain from start to the golden crystal, then topple them.
fireSafetyLesson: Plan your escape route before you need it — just like planning dominoes!
title: PYRA PRIME DASH

description: Climb the frozen shaft by cracking ice blocks overhead while dodging falling icicles.
fireSafetyLesson: Ice and snow never put out a real fire — call 911 instead!
title: ASH HEAP HERO

description: Steer Sizzle's parachute through wind gusts to land on the target pad across 3 drops.
fireSafetyLesson: If your clothes catch fire — STOP, DROP, and ROLL!
title: THERMAL TRACK

description: Copy the target melody on a step-sequencer grid and play your ember composition.
fireSafetyLesson: Smoke alarms make music too — test yours every month!
title: EMBER BOUNCE MASTER

description: Time your dart throws at the spinning volcano target — no flicking, pure timing.
fireSafetyLesson: Never throw anything at fires or fireworks — get away instead!
title: VOLCANIC TARGET

description: Hold to stroke upstream, release to glide — manage stamina and dodge rocks.
fireSafetyLesson: Never swim alone — and never near hot springs or lava flows!
title: LAVA RUSH ARCADE

description: Drag the claw to aim, drop it to grab crystal prizes from the moving conveyor.
fireSafetyLesson: Claw machines are fun — but never climb inside real machines!
title: FLAME DROP PHYSICS

description: Pass the burning ember before the fuse burns out — don't get caught holding it!
fireSafetyLesson: Real embers are NOT toys — never touch hot coals or fireworks!
title: BLAZE'S ZENITH

description: The epic finale! Defeat 5 unique mini-bosses with totally different attack patterns.
fireSafetyLesson: Real heroes stay calm — if there's a fire, get out and call 911!
title: RUKO'S FINAL DASH
